_comment: ATOS AI layer config. See docs/atos_ai_implementation_plan.md. Ships fully OFF. LIVE accounts are excluded in ai/config.py's code (not just here) and cannot be enabled from this file. Changes take effect on the next scan cycle (config is read fresh each call).
_shadow_mode_comment: When enabled_sim is true, shadow_mode:true means every AI hook still only OBSERVES and LOGS -- it never changes an order. A later sprint flips this to false, gated on its own shadow-evidence review.
_agent_comment: Sprint 3. enabled_sim=true alone just LOGS trade proposals (free). agent_enabled=true additionally calls the LLM (agent_model) to evaluate each proposal -- costs money per signal, needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. The agent's decision is still only LOGGED (shadow) until Sprint 4.
